note: Deterministic. No cloud project, no credentials, no network.

verification.detail: every state has a path to a terminal state
3 terminal states have no outgoing transitions
every waiting state names an owner and a deadline
every timer deadline has a row and every row has a deadline
15 reason codes, none spanning two source states
